author: vivirancy
name: audit
install_msg:
Thank you for installing audit!
Use `[p]auditset` to get started.
short: Logs message edits/deletes and channel/role changes to dedicated channels.
description: Reports message edits and deletions, channel changes, role changes, and member role grants/revokes to channels you configure with `[p]auditset category` (adminlog/memberlog defaults) or `[p]auditset event` (per-event overrides). Also adds `[p]audit overview`, a digest of recent modlog case activity from other cogs. Command usage, reactions, and voice-channel auditing are not implemented yet. Upgrading from the older `messagechannel`/`structurechannel` channels migrates them automatically on load.
end_user_data_statement: This cog logs message content (on edit/delete), channel and role names/permissions, and the IDs of users involved, to channels the guild configures. It stores no persistent data of its own beyond that channel configuration.
